_contract.purpose: Schema-level example for `bin/swarm security audit --json` with one medium-severity finding. Phase 0 baseline contract; scanner lands in Phase 3.
_contract.stability: shape is the merge target for Phase 3; severities are tunable during implementation but the four-tier ladder (critical/high/medium/low) is locked.

exit_status_rules.0_default: no findings, OR all findings are medium/low
exit_status_rules.1_default: any finding has severity='critical' (medium/low never fail without --strict)

sensitive_field_policy.location.path: Always relative to scope root. Absolute paths are never emitted. Symlink escapes are rejected, not followed.
sensitive_field_policy.location.snippet: Capped excerpt of offending text. Secret-shaped substrings (GitHub tokens, OpenAI/Anthropic keys, AWS keys, password=/token=/api_key=/Authorization) MUST be replaced with REDACTED markers before serialization.
sensitive_field_policy.evidence: Optional; when present, must be JSON-safe and may not contain raw command output. Cap at 4 KiB per finding.
sensitive_field_policy.redaction_applied: Required boolean. True when any field on this finding was redacted during capture. Consumers MAY choose to drop findings with redaction_applied=true from public dashboards.

scope_semantics.plugin: scans only files under the SwarmDaddy plugin root (the marketplace-installed directory)
scope_semantics.repo: scans only files under the active target repo (cwd at invocation)
scope_semantics.all: both plugin and repo; findings carry scope on each row

findings.title: Project .claude/settings.json grants broad Bash permission
findings.description: Project-local Claude settings include an unscoped Bash allow that lets any role-bound session execute arbitrary shell commands. Tighten to a specific allowlist or move the rule to a role fragment.
findings.remediation: Replace `Bash(*)` with a constrained pattern such as `Bash(git status:*)` or move the permission into a role-scoped fragment under .claude/roles/.
